name: Caminhada
notes: Walking in closed embrace with musical intention.

name: Contact
notes: Establishing the closed embrace connection.

name: abertura
notes: Opens from closed embrace to open (two hands). Key transition.

name: abriu estranho 1
notes: Strange opening 1. Foot pattern from pe descalco style.

name: avioncinho
notes: Airplane. 5-step figure — disrupts phrase alignment, can flip on1↔on3.

name: avioncinho (follower)
notes: Follower-led avioncinho variation.

name: balanco
notes: Balance / sway. Lateral weight shift in closed embrace.

name: basic 1
notes: Foundational step. Closed embrace, weight transfer left-right.

name: basic 2
notes: Second basic step variation. Builds from basic 1.

name: chave cruzada
notes: Complex figure combining arm lock with back-to-back. Lavaí forro school vocabulary.

name: chave de braco
notes: Arm lock. 5-step figure — disrupts phrase, transitions open→closed.

name: chuveirinho
notes: Shower spin. Both arms raised, follower spins. Manos alzadas.

name: ciclo de transiciones
notes: Full cycle of transitions through open positions.

name: cinco pisadas
notes: Five steps. 5-step figure — disrupts phrase alignment.

name: costas com costas
notes: Full back-to-back position.

name: dois pra aca dois pra la
facáo
notes: Leader steps forward-diagonal, creating a 'saber' shape.

name: giro (eje follower)
notes: Turn on follower's axis. Follower pivots in place.

name: giro junto
notes: Joint turn. Leader turns right-back in three steps — 3-step figure, disrupts phrase.

name: giro junto multiplo
notes: Multiple joint turns. Extended version of giro junto.

name: giros em linha
notes: Turns in a line. Sequential turns from pe descalco vocabulary.

name: hips movement
notes: Isolated hip exercise, often done with hands on wall.

name: magica
notes: Magic. Combines hand exchange with chuveirinho.

name: meio costa com costa
notes: Half back-to-back. Follower turns to face away while leader stays.

name: panamericano
notes: Pan-American. Uses two hands, built from cinco pisadas vocabulary.

name: paulista
notes: São Paulo style figure. Complex 8-beat combination.

name: piao
notes: Pivot/spin in closed embrace. Leader steps back, follower rotates.

name: piao invertido
notes: Inverted pião. Reverse direction of the standard pivot.

name: roots basic
notes: Roots-style basic with fuller body engagement.

name: simple turn (follower)
notes: Follower turns under raised arm. Two hands, one hand raised.

name: simple turn (leader)
notes: Leader turn, mirror of follower turn.

name: troca de mano
notes: Hand exchange. Leader's right releases, left takes follower's right.

name: walkingmachine
notes: Walking machine. Sequential walking pattern after chave de braco.

name: xique-xique
notes: Basic rhythmic step pattern.

name: xique-xique (transferencia de peso)
notes: Xique-xique with deliberate weight transfer emphasis.
